sloka: यः ते मन्त्र क्Rतः पाणिर् अग्नौ पापे मया ध्Rतः ।तम् त्यजामि स्वजम् चैव तव पुत्रम् सह त्वया ॥२-१४-१४॥
transliteration: yaḥ te mantra kRtaḥ pāṇir agnau pāpe mayā dhRtaḥ ।tam tyajāmi svajam caiva tava putram saha tvayā ॥2-14-14॥

translations.english: O wicked woman, I held your hand amid chantings of mantras with the sacred fire (as witness). I now disown that hand, you and your son begotten by me.
